adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` when `user_count > 0`. This overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 instead of 1). As a result, `showingLast` is false on the real last page, enabling the `next` action. The `next` action can set `offset` to `user_count` (via `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`), and `Group.findMembers()` then requests `offset=user_count`, which will return an empty `members` page, matching the described broken behavior.
